<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear M+2 peak at ~24% intensity relative to the base peak, matching the natural 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio. No other element’s distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., bromine’s ~50% M+2 or sulfur’s ~4% M+2) is evident. Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
